from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
import json,hashlib
import pandas as pd
ROOT=Path.cwd();R='reports/research/510300_fiscal_reason_month_end_dr007_comparison_v1';OUT=ROOT/R
def now():return datetime.now(ZoneInfo('Asia/Shanghai')).isoformat()
def save(n,o):
 p=OUT/n;assert not p.exists(),'已存事实保持：'+n
 p.write_text(json.dumps(o,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2,allow_nan=False)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
f=pd.read_csv(OUT/'全部28财政公告_三期限固定日历匹配.csv');den=[]
for h,g in f.groupby('horizon',sort=False):
 m=g[g.match_status=='MATCHED_FIXED_ORIGINAL_CALENDAR_STRATUM']
 den.append({'horizon':h,'all_original_fiscal_events':len(g),'matched_original_fiscal_events':len(m),'unmatched_original_events_kept':len(g)-len(m),'matched_fiscal_mean_change_bp':float(m.fiscal_change_bp.mean()),'matched_control_mean_change_bp':float(m.matched_control_mean_change_bp.mean()),'matched_mean_difference_bp':float(m.fiscal_minus_matched_control_mean_bp.mean()),'all_unknown_match_event_dates':g[g.match_status!='MATCHED_FIXED_ORIGINAL_CALENDAR_STRATUM'].fiscal_notice_date.tolist(),'original_28_mean_and_matching_18_difference_have_different_denominators':True})
save('原28全集与可比18例_分母及未知说明.json',{'at':now(),'status':'EXPLANATORY_SAVED_RESULT_DENOMINATORS_NOT_NEW_EXPERIMENT','all_horizons':den,'no_new_fit_label_account_or_stock_price':True})
proposal={'study_id':'510300_BANK_EXCESS_RESERVE_BUFFER_ORIGINAL_SOURCE_QUALIFICATION_V1','experiment_id':'E76','proposed_at':now(),'status':'PROPOSED_BANK_LIQUIDITY_BUFFER_ORIGINAL_FIELD_AND_PRIOR_USE_SOURCE_QUALIFICATION_NOT_REGISTERED_NOT_RUN','hypothesis':'DR007是资金价格，公开操作量与公告理由都不等于银行可用备用流动性。金融机构超额准备金率可能提供银行缓冲水位的不同状态信息；需先核余额/分母/机构母体及季度经济时点，率变不能直接当净投放、交易量、股市流入或纯原因。','why_after_E73_E75':'E73完整原因池0；E74财政标签H5下降26/28，但23例在月末5自然日；E75同年月/同月末状态18可比例财政H5均−13.969444bp、未写财政标签对照均−18.728951bp、差+4.759507bp，差值正负9/9，10原例无对照保持UNKNOWN。未建立财政文字超过日历的确定额外下降，不调窗口或建股市规则。','actual_limited_keyword_review':'已检索当前research/config/docs的超额准备金/超储率/excess_reserve，只定位2018降准机制解释；不宣称全repo没有旧数值或用途。下一先实际登记并读取旧库/字段/定义/终态。','different_target':'明确原货币政策报告的金融机构超额准备金率及真实机构母体/分母/统计截止/公布可知钟；不是DR007成交额替代、财政文字重分组或旧日历/利率差分重试。','fixed_statistical_quarter_targets':['2018-Q3','2025-Q3'],'quarter_population':'全部连续29原季度报告目标，覆盖最早2018-12原成员及2025-12原末成员；2018Q2仅若原定义/上一期数值原锚必要，单列不混当前母集。不是29个新股票事件。','source_plan':['先实际登记旧用途及来源合同；旧相同失败用途则结束，不把名称改成新来源。','先核现有央行货币政策执行报告/目录及季度来源，真实原全文优先；必要只定位官方原目录的实际链接，不猜URL。','原报告标题/季度、机构母体、比率定义/单位、季度截止、历史正文公布钟/首版与当前取得时点分别记录，UNKNOWN不回填。','全部固定29目标保留，缺原值/版本/钟不删除；最新已发布季度只作陈旧状态，不把季度末值改称日度资金余额。','源资格/不同用途/原完整成员支持成立才另题登记联合评分及完整账户，当前未选择金融模型、字段变换或参数。'],'next_registration_budgets':{'official_catalog_queries_max':4,'official_original_report_GETs_max':29,'request_attempts_each':1,'maximum_workers':2,'new_stock_labels':0,'new_model_fits':0,'new_accounts':0,'source_code_edits':0,'authenticated_requests':0},'current_actual_network_requests':0,'current_actual_original_report_reads':0,'current_actual_registered_financial_candidates':0,'old_failures_preserved':True,'original_full_account_targets_and_asset_scope_preserved':True,'current_view':'NO_VIEW','position':'UNSET','orders_authorized':False,'new_prospective_forecasts_enabled':False,'user_DR007_amount_access':'USER_HAS_NO_VALID_ACCESS','goal_achieved':False,'net_sharpe':'NOT_COMPUTED','root_consecutive_blocked_goal_turns':0}
save('next_experiment.json',proposal)
print(json.dumps({'解释分母':'全28保持；固定匹配18，10无对照保持未知','H5可比组':den[-1],'下一E76':'银行超额准备金率原来源/旧用途资格，未登记/执行，无金融候选','本轮新金融标签/模型/账户/源码':0},ensure_ascii=False))
